edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar (each, a “Party” and together, the “Parties”) wish to resolve the claims between them on the terms set forth in this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Subject to Plaintiff’s execution and delivery of this Agreement and a completed IRS Form W-9, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of $[________] by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within thirty (30) days after Defendant receives both items. The Settlement Amount is inclusive of all fees, costs, and other amounts claimed by Plaintiff.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, for itself and its present and former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and each of their respective present and former officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, insurers, and attorneys, irrevocably releases and forever discharges Defendant and its present and former parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and each of their respective present and former officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, insurers, and attorneys from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, fees, and costs, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, that Plaintiff ever had or now has arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement or any act or omission occurring on or before the date Plaintiff executes this Agreement. This release does not extend to obligations created by this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential and shall not disclose them to any person, except that a Party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, and other professional advisers who are bound to maintain confidentiality, or as required by law, court order, or governmental process. Where legally permitted, a Party required to disclose shall give the other Party reasonable advance notice and shall limit the disclosure to what is required. Nothing in this Section prohibits a Party from making disclosures necessary to enforce this Agreement.

4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment of the Settlement Amount are a compromise of disputed claims and are not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, fault, or wrongdoing by Defendant.

Please also complete the Settlement Amount and provide the revised draft for review.

The amount remains for client confirmation before the draft is sent as complete.
